headline: 9 on-chain Solana stake pool accounts + 2 validator accounts catalogued from SolanaCompass and Helius docs; DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId.

findings.text: D1: No EVM block-explorer applies (Solana only). Solana-native explorers (solanacompass.com, validators.app, jito.network) surfaced the Helius stake pool address 3wK2g8ZdzAH8FJ7PKr2RcvGh7V9VYson5hrVsJM5Lmws, hSOL token mint he1iusmfkpAdwvxLNGV8Y1iSbj4rUy6yMhEA3fotn9A, and validator vote account he1iusunGwqrNtafDtLdhsUQDFvo13z9sUa36PauBtk.

D2: No dedicated deployed-contracts page found on helius.dev/docs. The stake page (helius.dev/stake) is the primary user-facing entry point but does not list contract addresses. Addresses were sourced from SolanaCompass stake pool statistics page.

D3: No audit PDFs linked in protocol.audit_links. Helius blog states 'Sanctum heavily audits and maintains this contract' and Helius staking guide notes 'Five reputable firms have audited the stake pool program nine times,' but no specific audit report URLs were found in fetched pages. Sanctum's program is the underlying contract; specific audit PDFs not discovered this run.
D4: No GitHub repo recorded in protocol.github (listed as none). No deployment artifacts discoverable without a repo. Search returned no Helius GitHub org with a staking/LST deployment manifest.
D5: Single-chain protocol (Solana only). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: The stake pool's Validator List Storage Account (TCxWHorDSe3vWydw6MGwyexcqm3ZU9RT7VTqiCcN6y9) lists validators staked; SolanaCompass shows 1 active validator in epoch 974 (the Helius validator itself). No factory children beyond the single validator relevant to this single-validator pool.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: stake pool (pool), token (hSOL mint), admin (manager), admin (staker), other (deposit/withdraw authorities), other (validator list, reserve stake, fee account), validator (vote account + identity).

D8: All 11 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the SolanaCompass fetched page (3wK2g8ZdzAH8FJ7PKr2RcvGh7V9VYson5hrVsJM5Lmws) or validators.app/jito.network search result URLs listing the Helius validator vote account and identity.

rationale.verdict: Walked helius.dev website, helius.dev/stake, helius.dev/blog/what-is-hsol, and solanacompass.com stake pool page; 9 stake pool accounts discovered from SolanaCompass on-chain data and 2 validator accounts from validators.app/jito search snippets, totalling 11 catalogued addresses. DeFiPunkd read API is EVM-only and cannot be used for Solana; grading_basis set to mixed. No dedicated deployed-contracts doc or audit PDFs were found.

Official Helius staking page confirming native staking and liquid staking (hSOL) products; 0% commission validator.

hSOL is the Helius LST launched via Sanctum; accrues MEV automatically; smart contract risk acknowledged; validator charges 0% fees on inflation and MEV; references validator vote account he1iusunGwqrNtafDtLdhsUQDFvo13z9sUa36PauBtk via stakewiz link.
Helius is Solana's leading infrastructure and developer platform, founded 2022, backed by Founders Fund and Haun Ventures; offers RPC, staking, and LST products.
Helius validator identity HEL1USMZKAL2odpNBj2oCjffnFGaYwmbGmyewGv1e2TU paired with vote account he1iusunGwqrNtafDtLdhsUQDFvo13z9sUa36PauBtk on Solana mainnet.

unknowns: D2: No dedicated deployed-contracts documentation page found on helius.dev or docs subdomain listing all stake pool addresses; addresses discovered via third-party SolanaCompass only.

D3: Audit PDFs for the Sanctum-pools on-chain program not linked from protocol.audit_links or discoverable from helius.dev pages this run; Helius blog references audits by five firms but URLs not surfaced.
D4: No protocol.github recorded; no deployment artifacts (broadcast JSON, hardhat-deploy, addresses.json) discoverable without a repo URL.
D1-offchain: DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId; no EVM on-chain reads possible for this protocol. Attempted reads would require Solana-native RPC calls outside DeFiPunkd tooling.

protocol_metadata.about: Helius Staked SOL (hSOL) is a liquid staking token (LST) issued by Helius, Solana's leading RPC and infrastructure provider. Users stake SOL to the Helius validator — which charges 0% commission on both inflation rewards and MEV — and receive hSOL, a yield-bearing token that can be freely used in DeFi protocols such as Kamino and Mrgn Finance. The underlying stake pool is built on Sanctum's single-validator stake pool program and delegates all stake to the Helius validator, which passes 100% of staking and MEV rewards back to hSOL holders. Helius operates the validator with SOC 2 Type II certification and geographically redundant infrastructure in Amsterdam and Frankfurt.
